chunks: Bureyd ibn Mu'awiya al-'Ijli said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
about the words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Fear Allah and be with the truthful ones' [9:119]
He (peace be upon him) said: 'He meant us.'

key_terms.إِيَّانَا: iyyaana — 'us' with emphatic pronoun, emphasizing that the reference is exclusively to the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.الصَّادِقِينَ: al-sadiqin — the truthful ones; in Shia exegesis, a Quranic term specifically applied to the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt

ai.seo_question: Who are 'the truthful ones' (al-sadiqin) in Quran 9:119 according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Bureyd ibn Mu'awiya al-'Ijli, a trusted companion of Imam al-Baqir (a.s.), asks the Imam about the Quranic verse 9:119, 'Fear Allah and be with the truthful ones.' The Imam authoritatively declares that 'the truthful ones' (al-sadiqin) refers to the Ahl al-Bayt — the Imams from the Prophet's household. This is a foundational Shia proof-text establishing that true piety requires following the Imams, and that Quranic commands like 'be with the truthful' are specifically directing the believers toward the Imamate.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Ahmad Bin Aiz, from Ibn Azina, from Bureyd Bin Muawiya Al Ijaly who said,
‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [9:119] Fear Allah and be with the truthful ones.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from MuAlia ibn Muhammad from al-Washfiha’ from Ahmad ibn ‘A’idh from ibn ’Udhayna from t Burayd ibn Mu‘awiya al-‘Ijli who has said that he asked Imam abu Ja’far (a.s.)
about the meaning of the following verse of the Holy Quran. “Believers, be pious before God and always be friends with the truthful ones.” [9:119]
The Imam (a.s.) replied, “ ‘The truthful ones’ is a reference to us.”
